name: NE
recent: Northeast Group Berhad 近期有多项董事及主要股东的股权变动申报，以及董事经理 Ng Chay Chin 增持、独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon 减持。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收同比增长 35.3%，但净利润环比下降 20.1%。
notable: 董事经理 Ng Chay Chin 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日以每股 RM1.14 增持 249,500 股普通股。
risks: 季度净利润环比下降 20.1%，净利率由 32.0% 降至 23.0%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 42,851,000，同比增长 35.3%，环比增长 11.0%；净利润为 MYR 9,852,000，同比增长 38.8%，环比下降 20.1%；净利率为 23.0%，上一季度为 32.0%。

recent_en: Northeast Group Berhad recently saw several filings on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including open-market disposals by Independent Non-Executive Director Ong Kim Nam, an acquisition by Managing Director Ng Chay Chin, and a disposal by Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 35.3% year-on-year while net profit fell 20.1% quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Ong Kim Nam disposed a total of 106,300 ordinary shares in the open market between 5 and 7 October 2026.
Managing Director Ng Chay Chin acquired 249,500 ordinary shares at RM1.14 per share on 26 August 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon disposed 1,300,000 ordinary shares at RM1.14 per share on 26 August 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Ong Kim Nam disposed shares in the open market.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon disposed shares in the open market.
Quarterly net profit fell 20.1% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin declining from 32.0% to 23.0%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 42,851,000, up 35.3% year-on-year and 11.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 9,852,000, up 38.8% year-on-year but down 20.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 23.0% versus 32.0% in the prior quarter.
